facts.claim: The Ortstaxe applies to temporary lettings (up to 3 months) of any accommodation in Vienna, from hotels and holiday flats to campsites, and is collected by the accommodation provider; exemptions include minors staying for school, training or in youth hostels, students at Viennese universities and colleges, and stays over 3 months.
